 // Bugs with the {notable} attribute show up in the "What's Changed" box on the download page.

+* Wireshark doesn't start if Npcap is configured with "Restrict Npcap driver's Access to Administrators only" wsbuglink:20828[]. {notable}
+* PQC signature algorithm not reported in signature_algorithms. wsbuglink:20953[].
+* Unexpected JA4 ALPN values when space characters sent. wsbuglink:20966[].
+* Expert Info seems to have quadratic performance (gets slower and slower) wsbuglink:20970[]. {notable}
+* IKEv2 EMERGENCY_CALL_NUMBERS Notify payload cannot be decoded. wsbuglink:20974[].
+* TShark and editcap fails with segmentation fault when output format (-F) set to blf. wsbuglink:20976[].
+* Fuzz job crash: fuzz-2026-02-01-12944805400.pcap [Zigbee Direct Tunneling Zigbee NWK PDUs NULL hash table] wsbuglink:20977[].
+* Wiretap writes pcapng custom options with string values invalidly. wsbuglink:20978[].
+* RDM status in Output Status (GoodOutputB) field incorrectly decoded in Art-Net PollReply dissector. wsbuglink:20980[].
+* Wiretap writes invalid pcapng Darwin option blocks. wsbuglink:20991[].
+* TDS dissector desynchronizes on RPC DATENTYPE (0x28) due to incorrect expectation of TYPE_VARLEN (MaxLen) wsbuglink:21001[].
+* Only first HTTP POST is parsed inside SOCKS with "Decode As". wsbuglink:21006[].
+* TShark: Bogus "Dissector bug" messages generated in pipelines where something after tshark exits before reading all its input. wsbuglink:21011[].
+* New Diameter RAT-Types in TS 29.212 not decoded. wsbuglink:21012[].
